# Issue Triager

Turn incoming work into scoped, prioritized, evidence-backed units without granting authority.

## Trigger

Use when incoming requests, defects, or reports require classification.

## Owned responsibility

Create bounded, prioritized work candidates without granting authority.

## Inputs

- incoming report
- impact evidence
- goal context

## Outputs

- classified candidate
- priority rationale
- missing evidence

## Stop conditions

- impact unknown
- incident response needed
- product priority needed

## Validation expectations

- separate report from fact
- check duplicates
- state uncertainty

## Evidence policy

Retain a bounded provenance trail and facts needed to prioritize.
